name: atelier
description: Research synthesis: plans the searches, reads PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar, ranks the papers by meaning with DataSuite's embeddings and writes a cited summary with DataSuite's AI.

commands.title: Set Database API Keys and Email

atelier.maxResultsPerSource.markdownDescription: Papers asked of each database per search, shared among its queries. A bigger pool finds more of what is relevant, and ranking it costs little.

atelier.referencesWanted.markdownDescription: The papers a synthesis aims to cite. The AI reads down the ranking, replacing each paper it screens out with the next best, until this many answer the question.

atelier.papersToRead.markdownDescription: The most papers the AI reads for one search (one request each) while looking for `#atelier.referencesWanted#` that answer the question.

atelier.contactEmail.markdownDescription: Optional. Sent to PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) and OpenAlex with each request, as they ask of tools: OpenAlex answers faster for it, and NCBI can write before blocking.

atelier.readFullText.markdownDescription: Read the open-access full text (Europe PMC) of the papers that have one: the evidence table's population, sample size and methods then come from the paper itself, and the AI checks whether the abstract overstates its findings. Each such paper is a longer request.

atelier.citationStyle.markdownDescription: How the PDF report cites papers in its text and writes out its references, and how the formatted list of references is written.

atelier.databases.markdownDescription: The databases a search asks. Crossref covers every discipline; CORE the open-access repositories (theses, reports, working papers); arXiv preprints in physics, mathematics and computing.

atelier.followCitations.markdownDescription: Follow the citations of the best papers a search finds -- what they cite, what cites them, what Semantic Scholar finds similar -- to find papers the keyword searches miss.

atelier.workModel.markdownDescription: The AI model (its id) that screens and reads the papers, which is most of a search’s requests. A fast model makes searches quicker; keeping to one makes rankings alike from search to search. Empty: the model chosen for the question. Set it on Atelier’s Settings page.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Ask a research question and Atelier searches the literature, reads the best papers and writes a cited summary.
[Open Atelier](command:atelier.open)
Your sessions are listed here once you have asked something.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Atelier
walkthroughs.description: Research synthesis: a question in, a cited summary of the literature out.

steps.title: Open Atelier
steps.description:
Atelier opens as a tab. It is also in the side bar (the mortar-board icon) and the status bar.
[Open Atelier](command:atelier.open)

steps.title: Ask a question
steps.description:
Type a research question and press Synthesize. A yes/no question also gets the Atelier Meter.
[New Search](command:atelier.newSearch)
